development_needs.heading: Current Building Development Needs
development_needs.intro: From Buildings Masterplan Revision 1 (January 2026), these Phase 1 projects are our immediate priorities:
items: Spire repairs, bird clearance, and long-term bird protection.
Gutter clearance and a high-level roof condition survey to reduce water-damage risk.
East gable external repairs to address ongoing water ingress.
Extension roof concrete repairs (funding secured, works expected in the coming months).
Replacement extension windows to improve safety, warmth, and suitability for Kids' Church and Foodbank.

teams.name: Welcome and Hospitality
teams.description: Our welcome and hospitality team create the family environment we love at St John's Park. They welcome people at the door, serve refreshments, and make sure everyone receives a warm welcome.

teams.name: Park Kids Team
teams.description: Our Park Kids team disciples the youngest generation in our church, from under-5s through primary-aged children.

teams.name: Park Youth Team
teams.description: We disciple young people through Sunday Bible study and our midweek youth group Cornerstone, helping them meet and grow in relationship with Jesus.

teams.name: Worship
teams.description: Our worship team helps us encounter God's presence and give him praise.

teams.name: Food Bank
teams.description: Our Food Bank team serves local people in crisis, providing food parcels and a listening, friendly ear.

teams.name: Lunch Club
teams.description: Our lunch club team helps serve lunch and build relationships in this richly diverse, lively community.

teams.name: Cleaning
teams.description: Our cleaning team enables us to welcome people into the building during the week and gather together on Sundays.

teams.name: Admin
teams.description: Our admin team helps with the day-to-day running of the church. This involves helping with buildings, applying for grants, and staying on top of paperwork.

teams.name: Buildings and Facilities
teams.description: This team supports practical building projects from our masterplan, helping keep church spaces safe, functional, and welcoming for worship and community use.

teams.name: Eco Church and Sustainability
teams.description: This team helps us care for creation through energy-conscious upgrades, sustainable habits, and practical actions that improve the building's environmental impact.

teams.name: Community Partnerships and Enterprise
teams.description: This team helps explore partnerships and enterprise ideas that can grow local impact and support long-term financial sustainability.

teams.name: Creative
teams.description: Our creative team uses photography, social media, and video to show what God is doing locally and help people connect with church family.

teams.name: Audio-Visual Team
teams.description: Our audio-visual team helps make sure everyone can see and hear clearly during Sunday gatherings.

beliefs.title: What We Believe
paragraphs: St John's is part of the Church of England in the Diocese of Sheffield. We are committed to being followers of Jesus who love and learn from God, support each other, and serve our community and beyond.
Our faith is well summarized in the Apostles' Creed, shared by Christians around the world through the centuries.
We believe in God the Father, in Jesus Christ his Son, and in the Holy Spirit; in forgiveness, resurrection, and eternal life in Christ.

image.alt: Stained glass cross inside St John's Church

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding
paragraphs: St John's is committed to high standards in the safeguarding and care of children and vulnerable adults.
Download our safeguarding policy: St John's Safeguarding Policy 2025 (DOCX).
The Diocese of Sheffield's Safeguarding Adviser is Siân Checkley. Contact: 01709 309100 or 07741 013775, or email sian.checkley@sheffield.anglican.org.
